page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.3xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor based on the x86_64 architecture, providing 8 physical cores hyperthreaded into 16 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, matching a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware cache provisions include 32 KB of L1 data cache, 1.0 MB of L2 cache, and 35 MB of shared L3 cache. Instruction set extensions include AVX, AVX-512F, and AVX-512 VNNI, as well as AES cryptographic acceleration. There is no bundled local storage included with the configuration, requiring network-attached block storage for persistence, and the network interface provides a 3 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark results display modest single-core throughput alongside solid multi-threaded performance. Single-core evaluations, including a Geekbench single-core score of 1001.0, single-threaded gzip compression at 19.04 GB/sec, and a stress-ng single-core rating of 1106.79, place the instance within the lower percentiles. In contrast, multi-threaded workloads leverage the 16 dedicated vCPUs to achieve mid-range industry performance, evidenced by a Geekbench multi-core score of 6324.0, a PassMark CPU score of 13055.33, and a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression rate of 56.62 GB/sec. Memory subsystems maintain typical bandwidth, reaching 75.86 GB/sec for uncached 256 MB reads and 55.65 GB/sec for uncached writes. Static web serving reaches 9.98 GB/sec, and in-memory Redis SET operations achieve 11.35 million operations per second.

With its balanced compute and memory allocation, the ecs.sn2.3xlarge delivers cost-effective throughput for horizontally scalable enterprise applications that do not depend on high single-threaded clock frequencies or local NVMe IOPS. The presence of AVX-512 VNNI supports lightweight AI tasks, such as small 135M parameter model prompt processing at 827.7 tokens/sec, though larger 7B models see reduced processing speeds. This instance configuration is suitable for multi-threaded backend services, enterprise web serving, mid-sized database engines, caching layers, and CI/CD compilation workloads.

The instance features no local storage, relying on external network volumes, and delivers 3 Gbps baseline networking. Synthetic and application benchmarks highlight mid-tier multi-threaded compute, indicated by a Geekbench multi-core score of 6324.0, 11.35 million Redis SET operations per second, and 9.98 GB/sec in static web serving throughput, contrasting with weaker single-thread metrics like a 1001.0 Geekbench single-core score. It provides a balanced resource configuration well aligned with multi-threaded microservices, caching tiers, compilation pipelines, and standard enterprise web applications.
